answer.value: Text and multimodal (image-text) data: pre-training uses large-scale text and multimodal corpora; SFT includes multimodal reasoning data and GUI/embodied interaction data.
quotes: During the pre-training stage, we update all model parameters jointly using the combination of large-scale text and multimodal corpora.
